body.name: Dprojhat
body.def: For \(b^{\mathrm{cmp}}\in\{b^{\mathrm{OVS}},b^{\mathrm{const}}\}\), \(\widehat d^{-\ell}_{\mathrm{cmp}}(x)=N^{\prime}\widehat\Gamma^{-\ell}(x)\widehat b^{-\ell}_{\mathrm{cmp}}\), where the training-fold constant loading \(\widehat b^{-\ell}_{\mathrm{cmp}}\) is computed from the corresponding Moore--Penrose KKT system with the minimum-Euclidean-norm tie break.
